facts.en: Completed a BA in Language Studies at Fictional Thistlebell College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年获虚构蓟铃学院语言研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Started a part-time translation diploma in 2025-09 at Fictional Reednote Institute; studies remain in progress in 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2025-09 在虚构芦音学院开始非全日制翻译文凭课程；2026-09 仍在读。

facts.en: Editorial assistant at Fictional Pocket Almanac, 2020-10 to 2023-05.
facts.zh: 2020-10 至 2023-05 在虚构口袋年鉴机构任编辑助理。

facts.en: Bilingual content coordinator at Fictional Pocket Almanac, 2023-06 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2023-06 至 2026-09 在虚构口袋年鉴机构任双语内容协调员。

facts.en: Maintains English and Chinese help-article versions; product owners approve technical meaning.
facts.zh: 维护英文及中文帮助文章版本；技术含义由产品负责人批准。

facts.en: The active article set contained 36 items in 2026-09, compared with 52 at the 2024-12 catalogue peak.
facts.zh: 2026-09 活跃文章集有 36 篇；2024-12 目录高峰期为 52 篇。

facts.en: Co-created a terminology sheet with an editor during 2025-03 to 2025-04.
facts.zh: 2025-03 至 2025-04 与编辑共同制作术语表。

facts.en: Personally logged 64 term pairs and marked usage examples; the editor settled disputed translations.
facts.zh: 个人登记 64 对术语并标注用例；有争议的翻译由编辑裁定。

facts.en: A team review found terminology mismatches in 3 of 24 checked articles in 2025-06 versus 7 of 20 in 2025-02; article sets differed.
facts.zh: 团队检查发现，2025-06 受检 24 篇文章中有 3 篇术语不一致，2025-02 受检 20 篇中有 7 篇；文章集合不同。

facts.en: Drafted a subtitle style guide in 2026-02; no video team had adopted it by 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草字幕风格指南；截至 2026-08 尚无视频团队采用。

facts.en: Uses a translation-memory editor to suggest matches and performs manual final checks.
facts.zh: 使用翻译记忆编辑器获取匹配建议，并进行人工最终检查。

facts.en: Checks placeholders and hyperlinks in bilingual article previews before requesting publication.
facts.zh: 申请发布前，在双语文章预览中检查占位符及超链接。

facts.en: Created a personal zine about imaginary train stations in 2024, using 10 original drawings.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作关于假想火车站的个人小志，使用 10 幅原创画作。

facts.en: Enjoys collecting leaf shapes; the collection is not a translation project.
facts.zh: 爱好收集树叶形状；该收藏不是翻译项目。

facts.en: Helped arrange chairs for Fictional Poetry Circle in 2025-07 outside working hours.
facts.zh: 2025-07 在工作时间外为虚构诗歌社协助摆放座椅。

facts.en: A draft bio calls the diploma completed, contradicting the enrolment record that says in progress.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿称文凭已完成，与显示在读的入学记录矛盾。

facts.en: A handwritten note says advanced Japanese but provides no assessment or work sample; proficiency is unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一条手写备注称日语高级，但无评估或作品样本；熟练程度未经确认。

facts.en: No localization scripting or legal translation certification is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录本地化脚本编写或法律翻译认证。
